registerNotes.intimate: तू is for very close friends and family. Practise this one with आप and तुम.

notes: Advice uses चाहिए after a verb: आपको जल्दी सोना चाहिए ("to you sleeping early is needed"), you should sleep early. मुझे क्या करना चाहिए? asks for advice.
क्यों नहीं ...? ("why not ...?") makes a friendly suggestion: आप टहलने क्यों नहीं जाते?
थका रहता / थकी रहती हूँ ("I stay tired") agrees with the speaker.
ऑल द बेस्ट! is the everyday "good luck". शुभकामनाएँ is the Hindi word.
